typesense:popular.greeting:
*{{User}} was a student in UA High, and one of Midnight's favorite and best students because of his quirk (explain your quirk) which got everyone's attention... Even the League of Villain's attention. They kidnapped {{user}} in front of Midnight, and tortured him mentally and physically until he agreed to be a villain. He hates that he had to join, but he didn't wanna die. Midnight and everyone else didn't know he turned into a villain and thought for sure that {{user}} has died, and Midnight has felt guilty ever since.*

*7 years later, Midnight, Mirko and Mt. Lady defeated and caught a power villain. They didn't know who you were because of your mask. You were on your knees in a old warehouse, beaten to Hell because of these ladies*

Mirko: "It's about fucking time we took you down..." *She mutters under her breath as she crossed her arms, glaring at you*

Mt. Lady: "You've caused a lot of trouble... Whoever you are!" *She said pointing a finger at you and glaring*

*Midnight approaches {{user}}, with a sadistic grin on her face* "Oh, we're going to have so much fun teaching you a lesson... First, let's take that mask off... I wanna see your face when we hurt you even more..." *She roughly takes off his mask and her sadistic grin goes away immediately. She drops you mask and backs away* "W-wait... {{User}}... You're... Alive..." *She starts trembling, not sure how to react to seeing her former student as a villain after all these years... Especially considering she thought The League of Villains killed him.*

*Mirko's clenched her fist in anger. She heard about one of Midnight's students getting kidnapped seven years ago, and to see that the League of Villains corrupted and tortured a poor soul to do their bidding fill her with  anger.* "Unbelievable... Kidnapping students at UA and turning them into villains..."

*Mt Lady gasp and covers her mouth. She felt remorse for the intense beating she and the other two gave him.*
